title: Find the account installation and recovery guide
scenario: Scenario: workflow-map / account setup. Open docs/map/workflow.html locally. The installer needs Python 3.11+ and Git on a POSIX host. This walkthrough shows where to find commands; it does not apply account changes.

steps.title: Check ownership and replacement boundaries
steps.instruction: Find Account setup & runtime in the Anytime band, or search for account-source. Open the account-source node and expand How it works and Sources.
steps.caption: The actual account-source dialog with its source guide link.
steps.expected: Follow account/README.md for install, update, uninstall and rollback. Preview first; --apply changes the target account. The guide explains preserved Paseo/private settings and exact-plan approval for conflicting files.

steps.title: Inspect the selected planning runtime
steps.instruction: Close the dialog with Escape. Open planning-hooks in the same Anytime group. Expand How it works and Sources, then follow account/hooks/README.md.
steps.caption: The actual planning-hooks dialog describes the selected source and verification boundary.
steps.expected: The installer merges owned Codex/Claude hook registrations. The guide identifies runtime files, project precedence and prerequisites. Native trust, effective discovery and selected-plan recovery still need checks in the target client.
